race.description: Tab Federal Tony Campbell Memorial Cup
race.comment: CANNY QUEEN (4) has the right profile to take this out after holding fourth in FM BM72 company at Warwick Farm, where she beat MIGHTY MYRTLE and now gets meaningful weight relief. Her previous Warwick Farm run included interference, so she's trending the right way. Guymer rides and she profiles nicely for this feature. MIGHTY MYRTLE (8) is the main danger on overall consistency, with her strong record at this track and the held-up second to Feazabeel two starts back giving her a genuine winning platform despite a plain latest run. Hasn't won for a while, but continues to threaten and looks to get every chance. STORMBRINGER (10) is racing well without winning, missing by 2.8L in the Cootamundra Cup last time. Has speed to offset the draw and won't be far away. DUE CALZINI (5) can feature third-up with Boudvillain on board. CANDO ATTITUDE (7) can improve out to the mile for the first time.
